run_kinematics: run the kinematics function to compute forward kinematics for MuJoCo model bodies, geoms, and sites given qpos
run_tendon: run the tendon function to compute tendon lengths, Jacobians, and wrap point positions for a MuJoCo model
run_com_pos: run the com_pos function to compute center-of-mass positions, cdof, and cinert for a MuJoCo model
run_com_vel: run the com_vel function to compute center-of-mass velocities and subtree linear velocities for a MuJoCo model
review_smooth_module: review the smooth module that provides warp-backed kinematics and dynamics functions for MuJoCo mjx
